newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong govt paper yields ease in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong govt paper yields ease in moderate trade.

text.p: Hong Kong government paper yields were easier on Thursday in moderate trade, following slight falls in U.S. treasury yields overnight, dealers said.
"The Exchange Fund note yields were generally easier, following closely lower yields in U.S. Treasuries," said a European bank dealer.
The 10-year Hong Kong's Exchange Fund Notes yielded 7.14 percent against 7.17 at Wednesday midday and the seven-year note yield eased to 6.87 percent from 6.90.
The five-year note yield was 6.58 percent against 6.61 and three-year notes yielded 6.05 percent against 6.07 percent.
But one-week bill yields rose to 4.95 percent against 4.90 percent.
"Short term money rates also firmed on tightened market liquidity ahead of month-end demand and some corporate rollover demand," one dealer said.
Overnight cash firmed to 5-7/16 3/8 percent from 5-3/16 1/16 on Wednesday while the three-month was steady at 5-9/16 1/2.
